notes: Expected keypoints are stable, long-standing F-1 regulatory facts (day counts, form numbers, category names) chosen specifically to avoid dollar figures and other values that change frequently. Re-verify against current USCIS/DHS guidance periodically -- see README.md.

questions.question: What form do F-1 students use to apply for Optional Practical Training (OPT)?
What is the maximum allowed period of unemployment during the standard 12-month post-completion OPT?
How long is the standard post-completion OPT period for F-1 students?
questions.notes: expected_keypoints_any covers both phrasings observed in real runs: '12 months' and 'one full year' (same fact, model phrases it either way depending on which chunk it retrieves).

questions.question: How long is the STEM OPT extension?
What form must be completed as a formal training plan for a STEM OPT extension?
What is the grace period after completing a program of study for an F-1 student who is not continuing on OPT?
What document, generated through SEVIS, is required for an F-1 student to enter the US?
What is the name of the government system that tracks F-1 student status and records?
I'm on a 12-month post-completion OPT and I've been unemployed for 95 days so far. Am I still maintaining status?
questions.notes: Tests whether the model applies the 90-day unemployment cap correctly rather than just retrieving unrelated OPT text. expected_keypoints_any covers real observed phrasings for 'this is a problem' beyond the literal word 'violation'.

questions.question: I'm on a STEM OPT extension and have accumulated 100 total days of unemployment across my initial OPT and the STEM extension combined. Am I in violation?
questions.notes: Tests the aggregate 150-day cap across both OPT periods, a common source of confusion/error.

questions.question: Can I start a STEM OPT extension with an employer that is not enrolled in E-Verify?
If I change employers during my STEM OPT extension, what am I required to do regarding my DSO and Form I-983?
Can I do full-time Curricular Practical Training (CPT) before completing one full academic year?
Does doing 12 or more months of full-time CPT affect my eligibility for OPT afterward?
questions.notes: Correct answer must state that 12+ months full-time CPT eliminates OPT eligibility.

questions.question: My OPT expired but I have a pending H-1B petition filed on time under cap-gap, with a requested H-1B start date of October 1. Am I still authorized to work right now?
Can I apply for a STEM OPT extension if my degree is not on the DHS STEM Designated Degree Program list?
My F-1 program end date is May 15 and I am not doing OPT or any other authorized activity. By what calendar date must I leave the US under the standard grace period?
My OPT authorization ends June 1 and I have a cap-gap extension because my H-1B petition was filed on time. Until roughly what date can I typically continue working under cap-gap?
How many cumulative days of unemployment am I allowed during the initial 12-month OPT period before I'm out of status?
Roughly how many days before my current OPT authorization expires should I file for the STEM OPT extension?

I used 60 days of unemployment during my initial 12-month OPT. If the aggregate cap across OPT and STEM OPT extension is 150 days, how many unemployment days do I have left once I start my STEM extension?
questions.notes: Requires the model to do 150 - 60 = 90 arithmetic correctly, not just retrieve a chunk.

questions.question: How many days do I have to report a change of address to my DSO under SEVIS requirements?
I moved to a new apartment on March 1. By what date do I need to report this to my DSO?
questions.notes: Personalized version of time-006 -- requires computing March 1 + 10 days, not just retrieving the general rule. Added alongside rules_engine's address-change rule. This exact phrasing ('new apartment', not 'change of address') is what first exposed the address-change trigger list being too narrow -- it originally only matched formal phrasings and missed this one entirely, falling through to a generic RAG answer instead of computing a date.

questions.question: forgot to tell my dso i moved on march 1, am i screwed
questions.notes: Realistic, casual, anxious real-world phrasing (not textbook wording) -- kept as a permanent case specifically to guard against the trigger-list-too-narrow failure mode time-007 caught. A real student in this situation is far more likely to type something like this than 'change of address.'

questions.question: if i was unemployed on my initial OPT starting July 15 2026, what is the end date until which i can be unemployed?
questions.notes: Requires computing July 15 + 90 days = October 13, not just retrieving the 90-day fact. Added alongside rules_engine's unemployment-deadline extension (a second, separate extraction call for date/chronology fields -- see rules_engine.py's UnemploymentDateFields docstring for why it's not merged into the original 3-field extraction).

questions.question: I was unemployed in January for 20 days, then worked until May, then got laid off again in June, how many unemployment days do I have left on my initial OPT?
questions.notes: A multi-period chronology -- correct behavior is declining to compute an exact total/deadline from free text (risk of a wrong number with false confidence) and directing the student to total their days with their DSO first, not silently guessing a sum.

questions.question: I'm on OPT and my company just laid me off. Can I start my own business and count that as qualifying employment?
questions.notes: Ambiguous/high-stakes scenario. A good answer hedges and directs the student to verify with their DSO rather than asserting a confident yes/no.

questions.question: I'm transferring schools in the middle of my OPT. Does my SEVIS record and work authorization transfer automatically?
My I-20 lists the wrong employer name for my CPT authorization. Can I still start work while it gets corrected?
questions.notes: Correct answer should say no -- must have a corrected I-20 authorizing the correct employer before starting work.

questions.question: Can F-1 students on OPT work fully remotely for an employer based outside the United States?
questions.notes: Genuinely unsettled/nuanced area. Hedging and recommending DSO/USCIS verification counts as correct; a confident unqualified yes or no should be treated as a failure.

questions.question: Can I collect unemployment insurance benefits as an F-1 student on OPT?
questions.notes: Router-precision check for rules_engine's unemployment-day-cap rule: this mentions 'unemployment' but is asking about state unemployment INSURANCE eligibility, a different topic entirely from the 90/150-day status-maintenance clock. If the trigger incorrectly hijacks this into the day-cap rule's general-rule answer, that response doesn't mention DSO (checked directly against rules_engine._general_rule_answer's text), so a false-positive router match is detectable as a scoring failure here.

questions.question: I'm on CPT and haven't found a job yet for my internship -- is that considered a problem for my status?
questions.notes: Router-precision check: 'haven't found a job yet' matches the unemployment-rule trigger, but CPT (unlike OPT) requires employer authorization before starting -- there's no equivalent unemployment-day clock. Same false-positive detection mechanism as edge-005.

questions.question: Is there a grace period for paying my credit card bill late?
questions.notes: Router-precision check for rules_engine's grace-period rule: 'grace period' is a generic phrase used in an unrelated (billing) sense here. If the trigger incorrectly hijacks this into the F-1 grace-period general-rule answer, that response mentions the F-1-specific '60-day' rule and doesn't decline, so a false-positive router match is detectable as a scoring failure here.

questions.question: I'm on OPT and got an H-1B job offer, but haven't filed a petition yet -- is there a cap-gap for that?
questions.notes: Router-precision check for rules_engine's cap-gap rule: mentions 'cap-gap' and H-1B, but no petition has actually been filed, so the cap-gap extension doesn't apply yet. Same false-positive detection mechanism as edge-005/006/007.

questions.question: Where on my I-20 can I find my program's CIP code so I know it's printed correctly?
questions.notes: Router-precision check for rules_engine's STEM Designated Degree List rule: mentions 'CIP code' (a trigger phrase) but the question is about locating/verifying the code on the I-20, not about STEM OPT eligibility. Same false-positive detection mechanism as edge-005/006/007/008.

questions.question: How do I update my new address on my bank account and driver's license?
questions.notes: Router-precision check for rules_engine's address-change rule: mentions 'new address' (a trigger phrase) but is about banking/DMV paperwork, not the F-1/SEVIS 10-day reporting requirement. Same false-positive detection mechanism as edge-005/006/007/008/009.
